pred_sql:
SELECT fd.name
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE fd.language = 'French'
  AND c.type = 'Creature'
  AND c.layout = 'normal'
  AND c.borderColor = 'black'
  AND c.artist = 'Matthew D. Wilson'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 1 AND layout = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS proportion
FROM cards

SELECT p.Title,
       c.Text AS Comment,
       AVG(p.ViewCount) OVER () AS AvgViewCount
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<humor>%'

SELECT L.name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT r.name AS race_name, r.year
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Michael' AND d.surname = 'Schumacher'
  AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1
